chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Zayd al-Shahham, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The visitation of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equals twenty Hajj pilgrimages and is superior to twenty Umrah pilgrimages and one Hajj."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (AS) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith underscores the unique status of Ziyarat al-Husayn as a cornerstone of Shia piety, linking the martyr of Karbala to the purification of the soul. The comparison to twenty Hajj and twenty Umrah highlights the enduring spiritual efficacy of the Imam’s grave as a locus of divine mercy and intercession. This metric reflects the scholarly view that visiting the Ahl al-Bayt carries weight comparable to, or exceeding, the major pillars of Islam due to the Imam’s role as the guide of the faithful.
